data.content_ref: inline:Problem scope is audit:ritual — adjudication-ritual flags sustained (§11.3). The target's justification 'because SRC_006 and SRC_008 confirm a self-consistency property of the falsificationist stance' invokes a sustaining rationale (independent confirmation of a preserved property) that is explicitly rejected by the target's own lead clause: the flags are sustained 'NOT because of independent discovery'. Self-consistency confirmation across instances IS a form of independent discovery/confirmation, so the target simultaneously disclaims and relies on the same basis, giving an internally contradictory adjudication that fails the audit standard.
